card.headline: A winning start for the *new coach*.

caption:
Anorthosis win 2-0 in the new coach's first game. ⚽
Omonia Aradippou were the visitors at Antonis Papadopoulos.

📸 Kerkida
Source: Kerkida, Cyprus Times

alt: Result card over a photo of Anorthosis players celebrating: Cyprus League round 7, full time, Saturday 24 October: Anorthosis 2, Omonia Aradippou 0. A winning start for the new coach.

facts.claim: Cyprus League by Stoiximan round 7, Sat 24 Oct 2026, Antonis Papadopoulos stadium (Larnaca): Anorthosis 2-0 Omonia Aradippou, full time
It was new coach Barak Itzhaki's first game in charge of Anorthosis (Kerkida: 'Στην πρώτη παρουσία του Μπαράκ Ιτζχάκι στον πάγκο της'; Cyprus Times: 'Με το... δεξί η Ανόρθωση στην εποχή Ιντζχάκι')
